content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. - Regarding the relevant clause, your payments are conditional upon receiving a tax exemption approval from the tax authority, and any resulting payment delays are excused, leaving payment timing entirely outside of your control. I propose the following modification: The Client shall make payments in accordance with the agreed payment schedule regardless of any tax exemption approvals. Thank you, and I look forward to finalizing this.
